info.page.faq.title: FAQ
info.page.faq.intro: Find your way around ChoCho, review your account information and learn where to get help.
info.page.faq.draftNote: Answers describe where features sit in the current interface. Payment methods, fees, limits, processing times, verification documents, wagering, eligibility, support availability and account closure are held until the actual rules are supplied.

items.q: Where can I view my balance?
items.a: Sign in and open Wallet to review the balance information shown for your account. You can also select the balance in the header to open its summary.

items.q: Where can I view my deposits and withdrawals?
items.a: Open Wallet and go to Recent transactions. Use All, Deposits or Withdrawals to filter the list. Select View details on a transaction to see the information available for that entry.

items.q: Where can I find my available and active bonuses?
items.a: Open My Account and choose Bonuses. When you are signed in, you can also select your balance in the header and choose View my bonuses.

items.q: Where can I find promotions and offer details?
items.a: Open Promotions to browse the offers displayed on ChoCho. Review an offer’s own details and conditions before taking part. For bonuses linked to your account, open My Account → Bonuses.

items.q: Where can I review my profile?
items.a: Sign in, open My Account and select Profile to review the profile information shown for your account.

items.q: Where can I find security settings?
items.a: Open My Account → Security to review the security options shown for your account. Keep your password and one-time sign-in codes private.
Select Help in the header, Support in the footer or a Contact support button. The support panel opens without leaving the page you are viewing.

items.q: What information is useful when reporting a problem?
items.a: Describe what you were trying to do, what happened and when it happened. Include the page name and exact error message, if there is one. For a payment issue, include the transaction reference if available. If you share a screenshot, cover personal information that is not needed to explain the issue. Do not send passwords, one-time codes or full payment credentials.

items.q: Where can I find responsible gaming information?
items.a: Select Responsible Gaming in the footer for practical guidance and links to external support resources.
